caption: A Formal Model of Affiliative Interpersonality: individual affiliative behavior simplex
author: Stefan Westermann; Sven Banisch

stateSpaces.caption: Individual friendly-distancing behavior simplex
stateSpaces.description: Continuous Euclidean simplex representing the behavioral availability of one individual who can express either friendly or distancing interpersonal behavior. The two components represent the relative availability of friendly behavior and distancing behavior and are constrained to sum to 1.

dimensions.caption: Friendly behavior
dimensions.description: Relative availability or probability of friendly interpersonal behavior, associated with affiliative approach motivation.

dimensions.caption: Distancing behavior
dimensions.description: Relative availability or probability of distancing interpersonal behavior, associated with affiliative avoidance motivation.

export.description: A momentary individual behavioral state represented as a vector of relative availabilities of friendly and distancing behavior.
